spike_statement: Three big amusement parks stood here. Fire, closure and bulldozers ended all three by 1966. The free city beach outlasted them.

levers.photo_tone: Plain summer daylight on crowded sand, Parachute Jump and Wonder Wheel behind, faded boardwalk paint

meta_title: Coney Island Beach: Swimming Rules, Season and Park History
meta_description: Free NYC beach with a 2.7-mile boardwalk at the end of the subway. Lifeguards 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., late May to mid-September. Swim only in open sections.
